en-US.author: aesgalexis and contributors
en-US.description: Windows tray app for viewing local Codex usage limits.
en-US.longDescription: A small Windows tray application that reads local Codex usage and task-state metadata. It displays weekly and rolling five-hour limits through widgets, a tray icon and a multi-display taskbar indicator. Available resets use the installed, signed-in Codex client, which may contact OpenAI for account metadata. The meter requests no password or API key and includes no analytics or telemetry.
en-US.name: Codex Usage Meter for Windows
en-US.releaseNotes:
- Shows available reset credits separately from the currency credit balance in the normal usage card, with both values in the compact widget tooltip.
- Reads the authoritative reset count through the installed Codex client's read-only rate-limit interface, using its existing sign-in. Queries run only while the card is visible, at most once per minute, and never redeem resets.
- Distinguishes unavailable reset data from zero, marks retained counts as stale after a failed query, and documents the additional account-metadata request.
